name: Solar Energy Corporation of India (SECI) Internship
teName: సోలార్ ఎనర్జీ కార్పొరేషన్ ఆఫ్ ఇండియా (ఎస్ఇసిఐ) ఇంటర్న్షిప్
teBrief: ఎస్ఇసిఐ ఇంటర్న్షిప్ విధానం పునరుత్పాదక ఇంధన రంగంలో విద్యార్థులకు ఆచరణాత్మక అనుభవాన్ని అందించడానికి రూపొందించబడింది.
ministry: Ministry Of New and Renewable Energy
brief: The SECI Internship Policy is designed to provide practical experience to students in the renewable energy sector. The program aims to give interns exposure to SECI's various divisions, helping them understand the renewable energy sector.
briefFull: The SECI Internship Policy is designed to provide practical experience to students in the renewable energy sector. The program aims to give interns exposure to SECI's various divisions, helping them understand the renewable energy sector.
details:
The Ministry of New and Renewable Energy launched the "SECI Internship" program under Solar Energy Corporation of India Ltd. The Internship Program will serve as an opportunity for students to gain understanding about Renewable as a sector and SECI as an employer and help them evaluate future career opportunities. The Program will be structured, short-term, supervised placements often focused around particular tasks or projects with defined timescales. The work should be meaningful and must be mutually beneficial for intern and the Corporation. 

> **Area of Interest:**

- Renewable Energy and Solar-Wind Hybrids.
- Floating Solar.
- Solar Manufacturing and Battery Energy Storage Systems.
- Solar Park development.
- Solar Rooftop projects and Off-grid Solar.

> **Duration:**

- Engineering/M-Tech students: 3 & 6 months
- CA/CA (Inter),CS/ICWA/ICWA(Inter)/CMA students: 6 months to 3 years
- MBA students: 7 weeks to 6 months
benefits:
> **Stipend:**

- For training periods less than 6 months: ₹8,000/- per month
- For training periods from 6 months to 3 years: ₹12,000/- per month

> **Completion Certificate:**

- HR issues a certificate upon successful completion of the internship, confirming attendance and work supervision.

**NOTE:** The internship program does not include compensation of any kind, boarding, lodging, transportation etc.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a student.
1. The student should engage in research/pursue Engineering Graduate & Postgraduate Degrees/Ph.D. students in Renewable Energy/CA/CA(Inter)/CS/ICWA/ICWA(Inter)/CMA students/MBA students in HR/Finance/IT/CC from recognized institutions in India or abroad.
1. The applicant must have his own laptop for the internship. 
1. The applicant must maintain a regular schedule and demonstrate professionalism. 
1. The applicant must sign a non-disclosure agreement to protect SECI's data.

**NOTE:** SECI shall provide them with working space, internet facility, and other necessities as deemed fit by the concerned Heads. However, CA/CA(Inter)/CS/ICWA/ICWA(Inter)CMA/MBA interns may be provided the desktop as per the requirement.
howToApply:
[Online]
**Application widow will be open from 1st to 10th of each month.**

1. Applicant have to visit the official [website](https://www.seci.co.in/).1. Click on [SECI Internship](https://www.seci.co.in/page/seci-internship) under the career option in top menu.1. Click on the [register](https://www.seci.co.in/register/intership-form) button.1. Now fill out the Internship Form with the following details.

  - Name
  - Father’s Name
  - Date of Birth
  - Education Qualification
  - Qualification Status : Pursuing / Completed
  - Area of Interest
  - Email Id
  - Mobile/Contact Number
  - Address
  - CV / Resume upload
  - Desired Internship Period

1. Now submit.

> **Note-1:** The applicant can apply for an internship only once during a financial year.

> **Note-2:** No fee will be charged to the interns.
documentsRequired:
- CV / Resume
- Letter from the institution confirming enrollment and "no objection" for allowing their student to undergo Internship program.
subcategories: Education and training grants, fellowship, stipend

te.howToApply:
[Online]
**దరఖాస్తు వితంతువు ప్రతి నెల 1వ తేదీ నుండి 10వ తేదీ వరకు అందుబాటులో ఉంటుంది.** 1. దరఖాస్తుదారులు అధికారిక [వెబ్సైట్](https://www.seci.co.in). 1 ను సందర్శించాలి. టాప్ మెనూ. 1 లోని కెరీర్ ఆప్షన్ కింద [ఎస్ఇసిఐ ఇంటర్న్షిప్](https://www.seci.co.in/page/seci-internship) పై క్లిక్ చేయండి. [రిజిస్టర్](https://www.seci.co.in/register/intership-form) బటన్ 1 పై క్లిక్ చేయండి. ఇప్పుడు ఈ క్రింది వివరాలతో ఇంటర్న్షిప్ ఫారాన్ని పూరించండి.
- పేరు-తండ్రి పేరు-పుట్టిన తేదీ-విద్యా అర్హత-అర్హత స్థితిః వెంబడించడం/పూర్తి చేయడం-ఆసక్తి ఉన్న ప్రాంతం-ఇమెయిల్ ఐడి-మొబైల్/సంప్రదింపు సంఖ్య-చిరునామా-సివి/రెజ్యూమ్ అప్లోడ్-కావలసిన ఇంటర్న్షిప్ వ్యవధి 1. ఇప్పుడు సమర్పించండి. గమనిక-1: **దరఖాస్తుదారు ఒక ఆర్థిక సంవత్సరంలో ఒకసారి మాత్రమే ఇంటర్న్షిప్ కోసం దరఖాస్తు చేసుకోవచ్చు. >** గమనిక-2:  శిక్షణార్థులకు ఎటువంటి రుసుము వసూలు చేయబడదు.

faqs.q: What is the main objective of the SECI internship?
faqs.a: To provide practical experience and insights into the renewable energy sector.
faqs.qTe: ఎస్ఇసిఐ ఇంటర్న్షిప్ యొక్క ప్రధాన లక్ష్యం ఏమిటి?

faqs.q: Who can apply for the SECI internship?
faqs.a: Students pursuing degrees in engineering, renewable energy, finance, HR, IT, and related fields.
faqs.qTe: ఎస్ఇసిఐ ఇంటర్న్షిప్ కోసం ఎవరు దరఖాస్తు చేసుకోవచ్చు?

faqs.q: Can I apply more than once in a financial year?
faqs.a: No, you can apply only once per financial year.
faqs.qTe: నేను ఆర్థిక సంవత్సరానికి ఒకటి కంటే ఎక్కువసార్లు దరఖాస్తు చేయవచ్చా?

faqs.q: Are there any fees for the internship program?
faqs.a: No, there are no fees charged to the interns.

faqs.q: Is there any compensation for boarding or transportation?
faqs.a: No, the internship does not include boarding or transportation compensation.
faqs.qTe: బోర్డింగ్ లేదా రవాణాకు ఏదైనా పరిహారం ఉందా?

faqs.q: Can I apply offline for the SECI internship?
faqs.a: No, only the online process is available
faqs.qTe: నేను ఎస్ఇసిఐ ఇంటర్న్షిప్ కోసం ఆఫ్లైన్లో దరఖాస్తు చేయవచ్చా?

faqs.q: How do I apply for the SECI internship?
faqs.a: Apply online via SECI's website from the 1st to the 10th of each month.
faqs.qTe: ఎస్ఇసిఐ ఇంటర్న్షిప్ కోసం నేను ఎలా దరఖాస్తు చేయాలి?

faqs.a: Yes, SECI can terminate the internship at any time without notice.

faqs.q: Can I leave the internship program early?
faqs.a: Yes, by giving seven days' prior notice to the Project Head/Mentor.

faqs.q: Will I get a job at SECI after the internship?
faqs.a: No, the internship does not guarantee employment at SECI.
faqs.qTe: ఇంటర్న్షిప్ తర్వాత నాకు ఎస్ఇసిఐలో ఉద్యోగం వస్తుందా?

faqs.q: What should be included in the final report?
faqs.a: A summary of your learning experience, suggestions for improvement, and any innovative ideas.
The Heads of Departments assign Project Heads/Mentors to interns.

faqs.q: What if I don't complete the internship?
faqs.a: No completion certificate will be issued.
Yes, students enrolled in recognized institutions abroad are eligible.

faqs.q: What is the role of the HR Department?
faqs.a: HR manages the internship program, including design, implementation, and modifications.

faqs.q: How many interns can a department take at once?
faqs.a: Up to three interns, or six in specific cases like engineering/M-Tech/CA/CMA students.

faqs.q: Who is responsible for intern supervision?
